text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Falcon-san, you beat your target 
time by 0.2 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Really!? ...V for victory♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Falco-chaaan! Good luck in the Teio Sho 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Waaah, thanks for the cheeringâ

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A flawless run by Smart Falcon. Her start 
was sharp, and her pace never slacked 
along the way.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, she's got plenty of charm~ Oh, 
she's waving at us again."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She is truly the ideal Dirt Umamusume. And 
facing her is—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That strategy ain't my style at all! 
Sounds like a total drag!
choice_data_list:
How about a strategy where you endure the 
middle leg and save your legs?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's got no punch to it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well, I had heard that Espoir City was 
pretty headstrong, but... Her Trainer sure 
has their hands full~

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
It seems her personality is to act by her 
own rules even in training. Guiding her 
with that in mind is going to be tough 
work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but they look deep in conversation... 
...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"How's this sound? I'm plenty confident in 
my burst of speed. Plus, my start's got 
your personal stamp of approval."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
With how good I'm feelin', couldn't I just 
crush Falco right from the get-go?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? That Trainer, did they switch to 
being the 'listener' this time...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hooh... Figured Espoir City would buy in 
if the strategy came from her, huh? 
Certainly an effective approach for a 
headstrong Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
However, that's completely useless unless 
the Umamusume herself has the theory to 
devise tactics. How do you plan to steer 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Well then... I wonder which of these two 
complete opposites will win.
—The day of the Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Is today's star none other than this 
Umamusume?! The 'Falcon of the Dirt,' 
Smart Falcon! The mega-popular Umadol!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyooone~~â Are you ready to make some 
noise~~!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The spring dirt GⅠ season is finally 
reaching its climax☆ Let's get super hyped 
up for the Teio Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOO! Falco! Falco! Falco! Falco!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha, can't believe how last summer was. 
You've really gone and caught everyone's 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm the one who's gonna win. 
There's no other option."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, I brought a strategy just for 
that.

Espoir City smirked and gave a light hop. 
A pleasant sense of tension lingered in 
the air.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

And so, Espoir City heads toward the 
paddock.

Now, you hardly ever see her tensing up 
and tripping before a race anymore.

Without fearing anything, she marches 
forward, dignified and strong.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"L-O-V-E, Go-Go Falco! L-O-V-E, Go-Go 
Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you! ...I'll shine even 
brighter on the dirt!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To repay everyone who brought me this far! 
To give everyone the best race... —To 
deliver the ultimate thrill!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because I love dirt! I just love that 
glittering stage of sand so much—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't go having fun all by yourself, 
Falco.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: “O-Ooh...?! Look, here she comes... It's—”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here comes the rebellion girl! Is she 
the one to stand up to Smart Falcon!? 
Espoir City takes the stage!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Whaaa...!! Amazing... As expected 
of them...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san! You really are a teacher to me! 
Falco could never have made such big waves 
all on her own...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! I'm so happy! Is this really 
okay!? Even though I'm not perfect yet, 
still "in progress"— to be wrapped in such 
massive cheers!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah... You really say that kind of stuff 
with a completely straight face, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Even a year ago, ya know, she never 
got cocky even after winning graded races. 
She'd just toddle along after me during 
summer camp."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You keep saying you're not good enough 
over and over. Haven't you said that 
enough already?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Deep down, you're the one who's begging 
for a match against someone as strong as 
me."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I could run with you— Falco 
could learn so much more, and get way 
stronger."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Why you...! Stop acting so damn 
smug...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Then let's actually run and find out 
for ourselves, shall we?
